//: Which project types each type may depend on, read by scripts/check-nx-graph.mjs against Nx's own project graph. A type no list names is a leaf nothing may depend on: an e2e, test, live, exploration, coverage, conformance, tooling or workspace project. A contract — an agreement other projects hold to, such as the SDK schema bundle or the captured harness formats — is what the others may depend on, and depends only on what it is generated from, never on a consumer.
